correctness.rationale: At c∈(0,1/2], θ>0, θc<1 and r=cθ, β=θ(1+c)², exact w=1−u identities give w_next=w²+(1−w)v/(1+c−cw) and v_next=v[1−θ c w²/(1+c−cw)]. For prescribed positive u,v wedge B(u)=(2−u)(1+cu) nonincreasing, forward region invariant; v decreases and contradiction forces v→0, logistic lower comparison then u→1. Contracting difference estimates produce w=a v+b v²+O(v³) with a=(1+c)^−1 and b=c/(1+c)^3, so v_next=v−Kv³−Lv⁴+O(v⁵), K=θc/(1+c)^3, L=3θc²/(1+c)^5. Summation of Δ(v^−2)=2K+2Lv+O(v²) gives full two-term n^−1/2 and n^−1 expansions with O(log n/n^3/2) remainders; exact cancellation gives u second coefficient 1/θ. Independent SymPy rational-coefficient check corroborates algebra, not global asymptotics.
